title: S3W damped_spring settings
description: Candidate settings for the approved damped mass-spring model. Each numeric field is a quantity object {value, unit}. This file is the canonical contract: validation, UI field metadata and generated docs all read it.

model.description: Approved model identifier. Only values in the registry are callable.

x-s3w.label: Stiffness
x-s3w.description: Linear spring constant; must be positive.

x-s3w.label: Damping
x-s3w.description: Viscous damping coefficient; zero means undamped.

x-s3w.label: Duration
x-s3w.description: Simulated time span; caps total work together with dt.

value.description: Finite JSON number. Booleans, strings, NaN and Infinity are rejected.

unit.description: Unit from the field's declared set (or a declared alias).

model.title: One-dimensional damped mass–spring oscillator
model.equation: m x″ + c x′ + k x = 0
model.solver: Classical fourth-order Runge–Kutta (RK4), fixed step, state (x, v)
model.step_rule: n = ceil(duration / dt); the effective step is duration / n (never larger than dt); n + 1 samples are returned.
model.reference: Closed-form analytic solution (underdamped, critical, overdamped, undamped) used for the output reference check.
assumptions: Linear spring and linear viscous damping; no driving force.
Point mass in one dimension; no friction other than viscous damping.
Double-precision floating point; results are deterministic for identical validated settings on the same Python build.
Bounds are engineering and resource limits, not physical laws.
limits: Not fusion research and not production scientific software; an educational workflow demo.
Accuracy degrades as the largest characteristic rate times dt grows; see the stability rules.
Energy check allows a 0.1 % tolerance above the initial energy; it does not claim exact monotonic decay.

x-s3w.defaults_policy: Defaults are only ever offered for confirmation. They are never applied silently.

rules.title: Required field missing
rules.guidance: Supply the missing value with a unit, or confirm the documented default.

rules.title: Value has no unit
rules.guidance: Add a unit from the allowed set for this field.

rules.title: Unit not recognised
rules.guidance: Use one of the allowed units or convert the value yourself.

rules.title: Unit has the wrong dimension
rules.guidance: Use a unit of the right physical dimension for this field.

rules.title: Wrong type
rules.guidance: Send a JSON number for value and a string for unit; booleans and numeric strings are not accepted.

rules.title: Below minimum
rules.guidance: Use a value at or above the minimum.

rules.title: Above maximum
rules.guidance: Use a value at or below the maximum.

rules.title: Unsupported model
rules.guidance: Only the approved model damped_spring can run.

rules.title: Unknown field
rules.guidance: Remove fields that are not part of the schema.

rules.title: Too many integration steps
rules.guidance: Increase dt or shorten the duration so duration/dt does not exceed the step cap.

rules.title: Step larger than duration
rules.guidance: Choose dt no larger than the duration.

rules.title: Step outside RK4 stability region
rules.guidance: Reduce dt (or stiffness/damping) so that the fastest rate times dt stays below the reject threshold.

rules.title: Step coarse for the fastest dynamics
rules.guidance: Accuracy may be poor; reduce dt and check convergence.

rules.title: Energy grew beyond tolerance
rules.guidance: Reduce dt; a dissipative system must not gain energy beyond numerical tolerance.

rules.title: Deviates from analytic reference
rules.guidance: Reduce dt and compare convergence; treat the result as low accuracy.
